help_tag: Tag commands: Mention all group members. Admins only. /tagall [message]: Mention everyone with a random or custom message. /tagall (reply to a message): Mention everyone under the replied message with emojis. /vctag: Mention everyone asking them to join the video chat. /tagstop or /cancel: Stop the running tag process.
help_tr: Translate commands: Translate any message with Google Translate. /tr (reply): Translate to English (auto-detect source). /tr [lang] (reply): Translate to the given language code, e.g. /tr hi. /tr [src//dest] (reply): Force both, e.g. /tr en//fr.
help_vclog: VC Log commands: Show who joins or leaves the video chat. Alerts appear while an assistant is present in the VC. /vclog [on|off]: Enable or disable video chat join/leave alerts (admins only).
